rule: integrator-approved B2 slice S: version thirteen's NominalHeader representation byte 3 is `Simd`, admitted only under body_nodes(); bytes 0, 1 and 2 are unchanged and 4 and above stay unknown. The exporter writes 3 for exactly `#[repr(simd)]` with no packed, align or integer tag on a non-generic struct; every other SIMD form keeps a named fence. No lane, count or layout fact travels: every consumer maps the byte to its own Representation::Simd and re-runs validate_simd_declaration and validate_repr over every aggregate, imports included, and simd_shape and simd_layout on demand. An imported asm body's xmm_reg operand is re-proved by the consumer's own simd_operand. The legacy codec refuses a SIMD record by name
